tools.browser: installed Google Chrome, headless via Playwright

protocol.contexts: Fresh browser context per run, serial before/after on the same host.
protocol.transport: Loopback HTTP, uncompressed body for both builds; no WAN latency or mobile-network emulation.
protocol.instrumentation: CDP CPU sampling and getBBox instrumentation enabled identically. Raw CPU samples retained separately.
protocol.ready: First animation frame observing the initialized explorer API.
protocol.json: Response.json duration includes response-body consumption and JSON parsing.
protocol.synchronous: Elapsed event dispatch/debug-API call work; repeated-hover stage also includes its preceding geometry lookup.
protocol.two_frame: Elapsed through two animation-frame callbacks; includes intervening rendering opportunities, not completion of every CSS transition.
protocol.heap: CDP JSHeapUsedSize after app readiness; no forced garbage collection.
protocol.cpu: 4x is Chrome CPU slowdown emulation, not a measurement of physical mobile hardware.

operations.summary_render: Unchanged-mode refresh: Samples Dim, Medians Highlight, Density Off, matching initial modes.
operations.memory_facet: Select Memory resource emphasis, reducing ten workloads to four.
operations.clear_facet: Clear the resource facet, restoring all ten workloads.
operations.hover_rust_enter: Dispatch pointerenter at the Rust summary median.
operations.hover_rust_move_20: Read target geometry, then dispatch twenty same-target pointermove events.
operations.density_on: Turn density on for all ten workloads.
operations.density_memory_facet: Apply Memory resource emphasis while density is visible.
operations.density_off: Turn density off for the four selected workloads.
operations.reset: Reset the selected workloads and controls after the preceding four-workload state.
operations.language_hero: Open the Rust language overview from the summary table.

protocol.harness_difference: Candidate harness adds browser-version metadata and distinct output filenames; measured operations and instrumentation are unchanged.

hover_followup.reason: One final throttled repeated-hover measurement was 32.3 ms; CPU sampling attributed 30.8 ms to its preceding getBoundingClientRect. All primary values remain recorded.
hover_followup.protocol: Three fresh 390 px / 4x CPU contexts per build; coordinates captured outside event timing; 300 ms hover-style settling; twenty same-target pointermove events.
hover_followup.interpretation: Cached-coordinate twenty-move medians were 2.2 ms before and 2.4 ms after; no claim of a repeated-handler speedup.

limitations: Three repetitions are descriptive and do not establish statistical significance.
Loopback results exclude internet latency and bandwidth; CPU slowdown emulation does not reproduce a physical phone.
The unchanged-mode summary refresh is distinct from changed-state facet, density, reset and language-view operations.
Gzip size is a verified artifact size; deployment negotiation and live transfer are separate checks.
